strings.name: Evan You
strings.role: Software developer · Creator of Vue.js and Vite
strings.summary: Evan You created Vue.js and Vite, developing web frameworks and build tools with the open-source community. He became a full-time maintainer in 2016 and later founded VoidZero to build a JavaScript toolchain with a dedicated team. VoidZero joined Cloudflare in 2026; his website confirms the acquisition. These projects include substantial team and community contributions.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Birth date remains unconfirmed; residence does not establish nationality. Founding, public announcement and software release dates are distinguished. The November entry dates a conference recap.
strings.influence.rationale: Created Vue.js and Vite, advancing open frontend frameworks and development tools in web application engineering worldwide.
strings.facts.f1.label: Key projects
strings.facts.f1.value: Vue.js web application framework and Vite frontend build tool.
strings.facts.f2.label: Residence
strings.facts.f2.value: Singapore, according to his website; no nationality is inferred.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Developing the Vue ecosystem
strings.highlights.h1.text: Created Vue and developed its framework and community with maintainers and contributors.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Advancing frontend tooling
strings.highlights.h2.text: Created Vite and founded VoidZero, organizing a team to build tools supporting multiple frameworks.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Conference recap includes his talk
strings.timeline.t1.text: VoidZero lists his ViteConf talk on developer tooling in the agentic era; this is the recap publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: VoidZero announces joining Cloudflare
strings.timeline.t2.text: The announcement says he and the team will continue leading the open-source projects; his website confirms the 2026 acquisition.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Publicly introduces VoidZero
strings.timeline.t3.text: Announces the company and $4.6 million in seed funding for a unified JavaScript toolchain; this is not the founding date.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Starts VoidZero
strings.timeline.t4.text: In his 2026 retrospective, he dates the company’s beginnings to 2023, building a dedicated tooling team.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Vite 2.0 released
strings.timeline.t5.text: The project releases its first stable version with a framework-agnostic core and plugin support.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Announces Vue 3.0
strings.timeline.t6.text: His signed announcement introduces the new framework version and credits the team, contributors and community.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Becomes a full-time maintainer
strings.timeline.t7.text: His GitHub account dates full-time Vue maintenance to this month, with community funding supporting the project.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Publicly launches Vue
strings.timeline.t8.text: His later talk dates the public launch to this month; earlier code already existed.
